description: Verify that TCP in CLOSED sends a RST whose seq equals the incoming segment's ACK in response to an ACK-bearing non-RST segment (RFC 793 §3.9 p65 Event Processing)
approach:
[Objective]
Companion of BASICS_04: when the unsolicited segment carries an ACK, the RST's seq is set to that ACK value (the only sequence-credible information available).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in CLOSED state.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN,ACK (with ack=K) and bare ACK (with ack=K).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: RST with seq == K   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT emits RST with seq equal to the incoming ACK value.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_seq_<probe> — RST seq does not match incoming ACK
• Fail_timeout_<probe> — no DUT RST after the probe

verdicts.Pass: DUT emitted RST seq=ACK to every ACK-bearing probe — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_seq_synack: DUT RST seq not synack ack
verdicts.Fail_wrong_seq_ack: DUT RST seq not ack-phase ack
